inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month deadline to renegotiate the 2009 agreement feels less like a genuine route to resolution than a carefully useful countdown. After years of delay, officials can let tensions build, then point to an indefinite nationwide strike and claim the unions caused the damage. The ultimatum from SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council may be real, but the bigger question is whether powerful interests are content to keep the talks stalled while the blame gets redirected.
